settings.intro: Account, privacy, integrations, and how Purple talks to you.

rows.labsSub: Upload labs as PDF or photo. See trends. Educational only.
rows.pastEpisodesSub: Log seizures from any date or time
rows.sharingSub: Invite caregivers, set what they see, approve edits
rows.travelSub: Plan trips, anchor doses to home time

settings.moved: Looking for connections, alarms, or your device? They moved to Tools. Name, password, 2FA, region, language, and appearance live in Account.

today.emptyBody: Write a sentence, speak a thought, or snap a photo. Purple does the rest.
today.wearablesNudge: Connect Oura or Whoop to see how your body affects your patterns.

journal.emptyTitle: Your journal is yours. Write, speak, photograph, or record anything. I will read it carefully and remember it for you.
journal.emptyArchive: Nothing archived yet. Archived entries land here so you can restore or delete them.

meds.intro: Tap a med to see how you've been doing. Purple keeps a quiet ledger and nudges only when it matters.
meds.introWithMeds: Use Today's doses above to log Taken, Snooze, or Skip. Tap a med below for adherence and history. The Today tab also shows your dose list.
meds.emptyBody: I will remind you and watch for missed doses.
meds.manageHint: Tap a medication to see its dose history, edit the dose, or archive it.

history.title: Dose history
history.subtitle: Every scheduled dose across your medications, day by day.

meds.fixWithArrows: use the arrows to log past days

form.criticalAlarmSub: Sound an alarm and keep prompting until you confirm. Use for must-take doses.
form.reminderSoundCritical: Plays on a loop until you confirm the dose.
form.reminderSoundStandard: Plays once when the reminder fires.
form.timesSub: Leave amount blank to use the default strength.
form.rescueNote: Rescue meds are logged when taken, not on a schedule.
form.doseChangeNote: Changing the dose applies going forward; past logged doses keep their amount.
form.amountRequired: Please enter a dose amount (e.g. 750 mg).

detail.subtitle: History and settings
detail.historyHint: Tap a dose to correct it, or add a past dose.
detail.adherenceEmpty: Adherence shows up here once a few scheduled doses have passed. Nothing to do yet.
detail.interactionsNote: We're working on interaction warnings. For now, please confirm with your pharmacist when adding a new medication.

biometrics.noDataBody: Connect your ring in settings or pull data with Sync now once it's connected.

insights.intro: Purple watches quietly. When something shifts around a hard day, it remembers, so you don't have to.
insights.last14: Last 14 nights · from your connected ring
insights.noEventsBody: When something happens, log it, it only takes a tap.
insights.connectWearable: Connect a wearable to start seeing your trends.

timeline.intro: Seizures, journal entries, and doses, side by side. Filter by range, search, then export when you need to share with your care team.
timeline.emptyRangeHint: Entries, doses, and seizure logs from this range will line up here.

locale.title: Region & language
locale.subtitle: How Purple shows times and which language it speaks.

howPurple.seesBody: When you ask a question, Purple reads the last 7 days of biometrics, 14 days of journal entries, 90 days of seizure events, your current medications, and the latest risk forecast. Nothing else.
howPurple.patternsBody: Every night, a small job looks across 8 signals, sleep, HRV, temperature, activity, missed doses, mood, location, and seizure history, for repeating combinations. New patterns surface in
howPurple.actionBody: If Purple wants to add a medication, log a seizure, or change a setting on your behalf, it shows a Confirm card first. Nothing is written until you tap Confirm.
howPurple.privateBody: Your data lives in your account. Purple never trains models on it, never shares it with anyone, and you can export or delete everything from

sharing.intro: Choose who can see your health story and what they can do. Their edits never go live until you approve them. You can revoke anyone, anytime.
sharing.pendingEmpty: Nothing waiting. When someone suggests an edit it'll show here.

travel.title: I'm Traveling
travel.intro: Tell Purple your itinerary. We rebuild your medication schedule across flights and layovers, choosing each dose time based on the timezone you're actually in.

todayPage.firstWordsNote: You told Purple: “{{words}}”. It is in your journal now, and Purple is paying attention.

riskDetail.title: Why today reads the way it does.
riskDetail.noReadingBody: Purple computes a fresh reading once a day at dawn.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Upload lab work, blood panels, and medical reports. Purple extracts the values and shows how they change over time.
reports.emptyBody: No reports yet. Upload your first PDF or photo to get started.

reportsNew.title: Upload report
reportsNew.intro: PDF, JPG, or PNG up to 15 MB. Purple uses AI to read the values and match them to standard metrics.

care.noAccessBody: You don't have an active share with this person.

welcome.heroBody: A calm place to keep track of your sleep, your symptoms, your medications, and the patterns underneath them. Nothing here is sold, shared, or judged. I'm here when you need me, quiet when you don't.
welcome.whoTitle: Let me know who you are.
welcome.whoBody: Just enough so I can address you, and someone to reach if a seizure is ever logged.
welcome.bringsBody: Pick anything that fits. This shapes the prompts and the way I talk with you. You can change it anytime in Settings.
welcome.anythingElsePlaceholder: Optional. A few words about what you're managing.
welcome.connectBody: All optional. You can do this any time from Settings.
welcome.notifBody: Quiet reminders when it's time for a dose.
welcome.whoBodyShort: Just your first name, and what you are carrying. Everything else can wait.
welcome.tellBody: One sentence is enough. Write it or say it, however it comes out.
welcome.example1: Slept badly, skipped lunch, headache by 3pm.
welcome.example2: Felt steady today. Short walk after dinner.
welcome.example3: Forgot my morning dose and felt foggy all afternoon.
welcome.readingSub: Turning what you wrote into something it can track.
welcome.heardSub: This lives in your journal now. Purple starts noticing patterns from here.
welcome.savedBody: Purple is still reading it. What it finds will be waiting in your journal.
welcome.entrySaveFailed: That did not save. Your words are still here, try once more.

signIn.title: A quiet intelligence for your health.
signIn.tag1: Write, speak, or snap whatever's happening with your body or your day.
signIn.tag2: Purple listens, remembers, and quietly notices the patterns over time.
signIn.confirmEmail: Confirm your email to finish creating your account.
signIn.confirmedElsewhere: Confirmed on another device? Sign in
signIn.resetSent: We sent you a link to reset your password.
signIn.freeForever: Free forever. Open source. No ads.
signIn.oauthError: Sign-in didn't finish. Try again, or use your email instead.
signIn.enterEmailFirst: Enter your email above, then tap Forgot password.
signIn.trustLine: No ads. No trackers. Your data is yours.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password.
resetPassword.done: Password updated. Taking you to Purple…
resetPassword.openFromEmail: Open this page from the link in your reset email.
resetPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

doseCatchup.body: You may have missed your {{time}} {{med}} dose yesterday. Want to log it?
doseCatchup.more_one: And 1 more from the past day.
doseCatchup.more_other: And {{count}} more from the past day.
doseCatchup.updateFailed: That did not save. Try again from Meds.
